title: ceradenia pruinosa
intro: Ceradenia pruinosa, commonly known as the velvet maidenhair fern, is a type of epiphytic fern native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine, offering several health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can help soothe skin irritations and wounds. Therapeutically, Ceradenia pruinosa has been found to exhibit antioxidant, antimicrobial, and antifungal actions, which contribute to its medicinal applications. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which have been identified in various studies on the plant's chemical composition.
